scope: Deterministic failure injection and recovery certification

runSafety.destructiveFilesystemScope: exact HA soak run directory only

commonCleanupInvariants: MemoryGrantArbiter reports zero outstanding reservations after failure handling
All spill writers and readers are disposed
Run temp root can be deleted after cleanup
No partial mutation is reported as successful
No duplicate committed mutation is observed after restart or retry
Failure report redacts connection strings, API keys, ENC values, and SECRET references

faults.injectionMethod: configure isolated spill root with available-space threshold below scenario admission requirement
faults.expectedResult: operator fails before writing extents with a sanitized low-space error

faults.injectionMethod: bounded faulting spill writer throws after a configured byte count inside the isolated run root
faults.expectedResult: partial extent is deleted or marked unrecoverable; job fails and releases grants/handles

faults.injectionMethod: delay wrapper around spill writer and reader in the isolated run root
faults.expectedResult: throughput drops, adaptive storage-pressure telemetry is visible, and no timeout occurs unless configured

faults.injectionMethod: modify one generated spill extent under the exact run temp root before replay
faults.expectedResult: sanitized execution failure; no silent row loss or successful checksum

faults.injectionMethod: terminate worker after extent create and before completion marker or final metadata write
faults.expectedResult: restart cleanup removes orphaned temp root or marks persistent session spill unrecoverable

faults.injectionMethod: kill spawned worker process after job lease acquisition
faults.expectedResult: lease expires or fences; job is failed or recoverable and is not double-mutated

faults.injectionMethod: stop one Portal container while a sticky interactive session is active
faults.expectedResult: node-local interactive session loss is explicit; stateless requests continue through healthy nodes

faults.injectionMethod: stop leader/lease owner during a dense schedule window
faults.expectedResult: new leader acquires lease and scheduled job is not double-fired

faults.injectionMethod: stop disposable PostgreSQL container for a bounded interval and restart it
faults.expectedResult: health probes fail closed, jobs back off, durable state remains consistent after restart

faults.injectionMethod: set isolated temp-root quota/admission below the expected spill footprint
faults.expectedResult: job fails before unbounded spill growth and cleanup leaves no orphaned run root
